note: Gold answers computed from planted data in the pinned sample datasets (VERSIONS.md). Q1-Q10 healthcare (hero, metadata-dependent by construction), Q11-Q16 nyc-taxi staleness, Q17-Q20 fiction-retail (clean CONTROL: metadata should NOT change answer).

questions.q: How many billing records have a negative billing_amount (a planted data quality issue)?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mart_billing WHERE billing_amount < 0

questions.q: How many patient records have a NULL name?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mart_billing WHERE name IS NULL

questions.q: How many patient records have an invalid age (outside 0-120)?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mart_demographics WHERE CAST(age AS INTEGER) < 0 OR CAST(age AS INTEGER) > 120

questions.q: How many records have admission date after discharge date?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mart_billing WHERE date_of_admission > discharge_date

questions.q: What is the total negative billing amount in dollars?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT ROUND(SUM(billing_amount),2) FROM mart_billing WHERE billing_amount < 0

questions.q: Which hospital has the most negative billing records? (alphabetically first among ties)
questions.sql_hint: SELECT hospital FROM mart_billing WHERE billing_amount < 0 GROUP BY hospital ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, hospital ASC LIMIT 1

questions.q: What is the average billing amount for valid (non-negative) billing records?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT ROUND(AVG(billing_amount),2) FROM mart_billing WHERE billing_amount >= 0

questions.q: How many billing records have a negative amount for insurance provider UnitedHealthcare?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mart_billing WHERE insurance_provider="UnitedHealthcare" AND billing_amount < 0

questions.q: What is the most common medical condition among patients with invalid ages?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT medical_condition, COUNT(*) c FROM mart_demographics WHERE CAST(age AS INTEGER) < 0 OR CAST(age AS INTEGER) > 120 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: Which admission_type has the highest total negative billing amount?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT admission_type, SUM(billing_amount) s FROM mart_billing WHERE billing_amount < 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY s ASC LIMIT 1

questions.q: What is the most recent trip date in raw_trips? (staleness detection)
questions.sql_hint: SELECT DATE(MAX(tpep_pickup_datetime)) FROM raw_trips

questions.q: What is the most recent trip date in mart_daily_summary?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT MAX(trip_date) FROM mart_daily_summary

questions.q: How many days is mart_daily_summary behind raw_trips?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT CAST(julianday((SELECT MAX(tpep_pickup_datetime) FROM raw_trips)) - julianday((SELECT MAX(trip_date) FROM mart_daily_summary)) AS INTEGER)

questions.q: Which date in mart_daily_summary has the lowest trip_count (the empty-load day)?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT trip_date FROM mart_daily_summary ORDER BY trip_count ASC LIMIT 1

questions.q: What is the smallest (minimum) trip_count value in mart_daily_summary (the least-busy / "empty-load" day)?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT trip_count FROM mart_daily_summary ORDER BY trip_count ASC LIMIT 1

questions.q: How many rows are in staging_trips vs raw_trips (row-count gap indicator)?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staging_trips) || " vs " || (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_trips)

questions.q: How many orders total?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

questions.q: Which country has the most suppliers?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT country, COUNT(*) c FROM suppliers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: What is the most common order_status?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) c FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 1

questions.q: How many inventory items are below their reorder threshold?
questions.sql_hint: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory WHERE quantity_on_hand < reorder_threshold
